title: Lithium-6 and lithium-7 should have different behavioral effects

statements.text: If lithium acts through Posner molecules, the behavioral response to lithium should depend on the isotope, since lithium-6 and lithium-7 carry different nuclear spins.
statements.falsification_criteria: A careful replication finds no difference between lithium-6 and lithium-7 in behavior.

sources.quote: If this is indeed the mechanism, one might expect a lithium isotope dependence on the behavioral response
